ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The schematic diagram is divided into wind direction diagrams for different seasons. The dashed line in the figure represents the position near the equator, arrows represent prevailing wind directions, and gray areas represent pressure centers. The right-side seasonal diagram is marked “B”; the wind arrow near place B points from the Southern Hemisphere side toward north of the equator, indicating that this wind may cross the equator and enter the Northern Hemisphere. Reasoning: The wind at place B belongs to an airflow like the southeast trade winds in the Southern Hemisphere. After crossing the equator and entering the Northern Hemisphere, it will be deflected to the right under the influence of the Coriolis force in the Northern Hemisphere, forming the southwest monsoon. This wind comes from the ocean and carries a large amount of water vapor. When passing through areas such as South Asia and Southeast Asia, it easily brings heavy precipitation; if the precipitation intensity is large or the duration is long, it may trigger flood disasters.

method.method_draft: 先读图：右侧季节图中，乙位于赤道附近的南半球一侧，风箭头指向赤道以北，表示该风可由南半球越过赤道进入北半球；图中还有气压中心与风向标注。再读题：题问“乙处风越过赤道后”对经过地区的影响。关键桥梁：南半球东南信风越过赤道后受北半球地转偏向力影响，偏转成西南季风；该风来自海洋，水汽充足，进入南亚、东南亚等地后带来强降水。若降水强度大或持续时间长，则可能造成洪涝灾害。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：示意图分为不同季节的风向图，图中虚线表示赤道附近位置，箭头表示盛行风向，灰色区域表示气压中心。右侧季节图中标有“乙”，乙处附近的风箭头由南半球一侧指向赤道以北，说明该风可能越过赤道进入北半球。
推理：乙处风属于南半球东南信风一类的气流，越过赤道后进入北半球，会受北半球地转偏向力影响向右偏转，形成西南季风。该风来自海洋，携带大量水汽，经过南亚、东南亚等地区时容易带来强降水；若降水强度大或持续时间长，就可能引发洪涝灾害。
